description:
Make a file smaller: a preset, optionally a target size, optionally smaller pictures or video.
A result that misses its target is still written and listed in `over_target` in the answer. Takes image, video, audio, pdf files.

half.description: Pictures: half the width and height.

max_side.description: Pictures: the longest side at most this many pixels.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

strong.description: Smaller files, lower quality (the default is balanced).

target_mb.description: Or as a size in megabytes.

target_percent.description: What each result must fit, as a share of the original, 5 to 95 percent.

video_height.description: Video: at most this many pixels high (1080, 720, 480...).

name: compress
title: Compress
